body_es: AWS proporciona un conjunto completo e integrado de herramientas y servicios para mantener seguridad, gobernanza y cumplimiento normativo en toda la organización. El servicio AWS IAM permite implementar control granular del acceso a recursos basado en el principio fundamental de menor privilegio, otorgando solo los permisos necesarios. AWS Config proporciona evaluación continua y automatizada de configuraciones de recursos contra políticas deseadas y mejores prácticas. AWS CloudTrail registra exhaustivamente todas las acciones de API para auditoría, cumplimiento e investigación de incidentes. Conviene no confundirlo con Amazon CloudWatch: CloudWatch responde «¿cómo va el sistema?» con métricas, logs y alarmas de rendimiento, mientras que CloudTrail responde «¿quién hizo esto?» con el registro de llamadas a la API — la guía del examen los asocia respectivamente a monitorización y a auditoría. AWS Artifact proporciona acceso seguro a reportes de cumplimiento de AWS verificados de terceros, como SOC 2 Type II y PCI DSS. AWS Security Hub centraliza y correlaciona hallazgos de seguridad de múltiples servicios y fuentes en un único dashboard. AWS ofrece conformidad integrada con estándares como HIPAA, GDPR, FedRAMP y CIS Benchmarks. Las organizaciones pueden usar estas herramientas para mantener altos estándares de seguridad y satisfacer requisitos regulatorios específicos.
body_en: AWS provides a comprehensive and integrated set of tools and services to maintain security, governance, and regulatory compliance across the organization. The AWS IAM service enables granular access control to resources based on the fundamental principle of least privilege, granting only necessary permissions. AWS Config provides continuous and automated evaluation of resource configurations against desired policies and best practices. AWS CloudTrail exhaustively logs all API actions for audit, compliance, and incident investigation. It is easy to confuse with Amazon CloudWatch: CloudWatch answers 'how is the system doing?' with performance metrics, logs, and alarms, while CloudTrail answers 'who did this?' with the record of API calls — the exam guide ties the two to monitoring and auditing respectively. AWS Artifact provides secure access to third-party verified AWS compliance reports, such as SOC 2 Type II and PCI DSS. AWS Security Hub centralizes and correlates security findings from multiple services and sources in a single dashboard. AWS offers integrated compliance with standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, FedRAMP, and CIS Benchmarks. Organizations can use these tools to maintain high security standards and meet specific regulatory requirements. AWS Secrets Manager and AWS KMS provide encryption services that protect sensitive data automatically. CloudTrail logs all API calls, creating an auditable record of who accessed what and when, supporting compliance with regulations like SOC 2, HIPAA, and GDPR. The combination of these tools creates a comprehensive security and compliance posture. Organizations should regularly review CloudTrail logs and security findings to identify and remediate risks proactively. Integrating AWS Security Hub findings with your SIEM and incident response workflows ensures rapid response to security events. AWS Conformance Packs allow automating compliance checks against specific regulatory frameworks without manual processes.
example_code:
# Enable CloudTrail for audit logging
aws cloudtrail create-trail --name audit-trail --s3-bucket-name audit-bucket

# Enable Config to monitor compliance
aws configservice start-config-rules-evaluation

# Generate IAM credential report
aws iam generate-credential-report
aws iam get-credential-report

# Access Security Hub findings
aws securityhub get-findings --query 'Findings[].{Title:Title,Severity:Severity}'
